correctness.rationale: A pair-weight-four nonzero word must be a Hamming-weight-three codeword supported on three cyclic consecutive coordinates, equivalent to xor-zero of the three corresponding nonzero F₂⁴ columns. GL(4,2) acts freely and transitively on fixed ordered distinct starting columns; fixing (1,2) leaves 13! permutations, and dividing the resulting generating polynomial coefficients by 96 counts distinct indexed codes. The acyclic subset/last-two columns DP counts each tail and both wrap-around triples exactly once. An independent C++ implementation of this recurrence reproduced the full exact seven unnormalized coefficients [1642251264,2567162880,1512023040,434319360,65617920,5492736,153600], sum 13!; integer division gives claimed profile, sum 64864800. Zero-triple condition and any two adjacent columns yield pair distance exactly five, while any B>0 yields four. This is an exhaustive finite algorithm, not samples.

value.rationale: The projective geometry PG(3,2) Hamming code is canonical; cyclic ordering changes symbol-pair performance and the complete seven-value distribution measures the availability and abundance of optimal interleavers. Counting all indexed configurations exactly via a meaningful finite recurrence gives a reusable natural design invariant not supplied by existence statements or length-seven tables.

final_claim: Across all 64,864,800 indexed binary [15,11,3] Hamming codes, pair-weight-four multiplicity B takes 0..6 with frequencies (17106784,26741280,15750240,4524160,683520,57216,1600); exactly B=0 codes have maximal pair distance five within this family.
